verdict.rationale: The axis applies to Terraform: HCP Terraform is a hosted service that stores workspace state, and Terraform ships an official MCP server, so a buyer could fairly ask about an AI-training opt-out or a no-training commitment. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any such data-usage control or policy, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
